  • Prospectar cargos de gestão e C-Levels de grandes empresas brasileiras;
  • Realizar ligações de descoberta para identificar as necessidades e desejos das pessoas que conversa;
  • Manter registros precisos de interações com os clientes, pedidos e comunicações (Hubspot);
  • Gerenciar e contornar objeções dos prospects;
  • Gerenciar uma grande quantidade de oportunidades e atividades de follow-ups;
  • Criação e execução da estratégia de comunicação com as empresas em prospecção;
  • Construção de relacionamento e mapeamento de influências na empresa em prospecção;
  • Alcançar ou superar metas de vendas estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Participar de treinamentos e desenvolvimento para aprimorar habilidades de vendas;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre produtos, serviços e políticas da empresa.
  • Cumprir todas as políticas e padrões de qualidade da empresa;
  • Colaborar com os times de Vendas e Marketing para desenvolvimento de ações para evolução do funil de vendas.
  • Requisitos e Qualificações:
  • Ser formado em Comunicação, Marketing, Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatas ou ter experiência prévia como BDR;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento, adaptando-se rapidamente a novas informações e desafios;
  • Foco em resultados e motivação para atingir metas de vendas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Atitude proativa e orientada para o cliente;
  • Desenvoltura em ligações, e-mails ou pessoalmente;
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre vendas consultivas - SPIN Selling, Challenger Sales ou similares;
  • Gostar de trabalhar com ligações - sendo esse nosso principal modelo de prospecção;
  • Ter disponibilidade para viagens institucionais e de visita a cliente quando necessário - esporádicas;
  • Experiência prévia como BDR Enterprise B2B;
  • Experiência com CRM Hubspot.
  • Diferenciais:
  • Conhecimento sobre produtos e serviços para o mercado Fiscal;
  • Experiência com venda de produtos SaaS.
  • Experiência com estratégia de ABM (Account-Based Marketing).

Benefícios

Temos experiência junto às maiores empresas do Brasil e levamos isso como bagagem na construção de soluções eficientes e escaláveis.

A colaboração está no nosso DNA. Aqui, trabalhamos lado a lado (na prática, em home office), e em pouco tempo você estará não só aprendendo, mas também trocando experiências e contribuindo ativamente.

  • Remuneração competitiva com o mercado + variável por batimento de metas
  • Possibilidade de ganhar PLR anual por desempenho (até 7 salários)
  • Auxílio Home Office no valor de R$300
  • Refeição R$42,00 ao dia útil
  • Convênio saúde Bradesco sem coparticipação

  • Seguro de vida

  • Autonomia, aprendizado e trocas constantes
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com encontros presenciais pontuais no RJ para integração do time e, eventualmente, com clientes em todo o Brasil

Processo seletivo

Etapas do Processo: Candidatura, Vídeo Desafio, Bate-Papo com Gente e Cultura, Bate-Papo com a Liderança - com case, Bate-Papo Final com Head comercial, Teste de Integridade, Contratação. title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.
In the first week, expect to:
  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training process which conveys our value proposition, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
In the first month, expect to:
  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Be able to accurately articulate Toptal’s value proposition and process.
  • Be able to speak to incoming leads, understand the clients’ needs, overcome any objections, present the value proposition of Toptal, and close leads that are a good fit for Toptal.
  • Work alongside the various business units to ensure your prospects are progressing through the funnel.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first three months, expect to:
  • Be fully ramped up and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Possess a healthy pipeline of prospects that are working through your funnel.
  • Exhibit a successful track record of hitting sales goals.
In the first six months, expect to:
  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Identify process improvement areas to help increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
  • Continue to implement sales best practices for client interactions and follow-up.
In the first year, expect to:
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Continue to gain and close new business along with managing your funnel to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (i.e. Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/ leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Overview

Join to apply for the Paid Media Specialist role at Launch Potato .

About Us

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Ready to level up your media buying career with a world-class US company—all from the comfort of your home? This is your chance to grow into a Media Buying expert, managing large-scale budgets and driving real results for top advertisers. No prior native experience? No problem. We’ll guide you with mentorship, data-driven strategies, and hands-on training across platforms like Taboola and Outbrain. At Launch Potato, you'll collaborate with a diverse, high-performing team across the Americas, gaining global experience in one of the most exciting spaces in digital media: Finance and Money Management. If you’re looking for a role where you’re trusted, supported, and set up to thrive, this is it.

MUST HAVE

  • Hands-on experience running social or native ad campaigns across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Taboola, Outbrain, Revcontent, Mediago, or Liveintent
  • Proven ability to monitor and optimize campaign performance using data
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on executional excellence and task management
  • Ability to collaborate across functions and communicate clearly in a remote work environment
  • Display an attitude of positivity and willingness to embrace change, not getting discouraged when business or cross-functional needs change
  • Passion for performance marketing and a desire to grow within the Make Money/Manage Money vertical of our largest brand, FinanceBuzz

Experience

2+ years of media buying or programmatic experience, with a focus on performance-driven results across social or native ad campaigns.

Your Role

Support the success and growth of our Make Money/Manage Money native and social media campaigns by executing campaign builds, monitoring performance, and assisting in optimizations that help scale winning strategies.

Outcomes

  • Execute and manage native ad campaigns across platforms such as Taboola, Outbrain, Revcontent, Mediago, or Liveintent with speed and accuracy
  • Monitor daily performance metrics and implement optimizations to creative, bids, and placements
  • Partner with senior media buyers to launch new campaigns and expand existing ones while supporting strategic growth
  • Facilitate creative testing by assisting with copy iteration, image/video swaps, and tracking results
  • Conduct competitor research and performance audits to surface new testing opportunities
  • Collaborate with the Content and Paid Media teams to ensure seamless campaign setup and timely asset delivery
  • Maintain campaign documentation and update performance trackers regularly to support team throughput

Competencies

  • Execution-Oriented: Manages deliverables independently and consistently follows through on tasks that enable campaign momentum and growth
  • Detail-Driven: Demonstrates accuracy in reporting, campaign QA, and implementation of optimizations
  • Analytical Thinker: Understand key ad metrics and translate data into actionable strategies that improve funnel performance
  • Collaborative: Works effectively across team lines with buyers, content creators, and analysts to move campaigns forward
  • Curious: Asks the right questions, seeks to understand performance drivers, and uses data to guide recommendations
  • Proactive Communicator: Provides regular updates, flags issues early, and clearly communicates changes or learnings to stakeholders
  • Coachability: Open to feedback, quickly applies learnings, and demonstrates a strong desire to grow into a more strategic buyer

EEO / Diversity

We’re committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Partner Operations Analyst
description:
About 1Password

At 1Password, we're building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Extended Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 165,000 businesses and millions of people trust us to provide seamless, secure access to their most critical information.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Partners are central to our future growth. The Global Partner Team empowers them with the tools, programs, and resources they need to succeed and grow with 1Password.

We're looking for a Partner Operations Manager to streamline internal processes, reporting, policies, and communications that support our partner-facing teams. In this role, you'll improve partner tools, enhance workflows, and drive operational efficiency—internally and externally.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate with teams across partnerships, sales, legal, and marketing. Reporting to a Senior Manager in Revenue Operations, you'll help scale our partner program and contribute to 1Password's continued growth.

You'll join 1Password as a key member of the Revenue Operations team, working cross-functionally with partnerships, sales, legal, and marketing to drive operational excellence in our partner program. You'll report to a Senior Manager within Revenue Operations, under the VP of Revenue Operations.

This is a Remote opportunity within Canada and the United States.

What we're looking for

  • Partner Operations/Revenue Operations - You have a minimum of 3 years experience driving success strategies for a growing partner program, partnership management, or relevant experience within Revenue Operations in the technology industry. You have the experience and confidence to identify areas for strategic improvements, advocate for them internally, implement them, and evolve them.
  • Strong Understanding of Salesforce required - You have experience working with Salesforce and have a strong understanding of its core functionalities around data management, reporting, dashboarding and large scale updates. Salesforce administrator certification is an asset.
  • The Ability to Build and Evolve - The Partner Program is primed with huge growth, but there is so much to still figure out to ensure that our partners are armed for success while scaling our business globally. We need a proactive, independent thinker with high energy and positive attitude. You'll bring a flexible and pragmatic mindset, leverage your resources to solve problems with much ambiguity, and adapt to a fast-paced changing environment.
  • Structured and Organized Approach - You're hyper-organized, and can manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously. You're able to manage multiple projects at various stages that require cross functional collaboration and alignment.
  • A Good Human Being - You act with integrity, kindness and respect, always. You're confident enough to challenge the norms and suggest meaningful changes, but humble enough to be part of a strong culture and team that embraces diversity and open discussion.

What you can expect

  • Partner Process—Internal & External - Own the partners sales process internally and externally from end to end. This includes ensuring that current processes are optimized and scalable, and proactively building additional functionalities as the business evolves. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to create workflows, automations and improvements to drive incremental value.
  • Partner Performance Reporting - You will implement the necessary data structure and reporting to support the tracking and measurements of success for partnerships. You will monitor systems and workflows to ensure data integrity in common metrics such as ARR, partner adoption, engagement, marketing activities, and incentive/spiffs are common measurements of success.
  • Global Partner Success and Health - Behind the scenes, you're ensuring that our partner-facing teams have everything they need to be successful, working alongside several internal teams to ensure that we have the right automations and processes in place, tools, documentation, policies, and communications to recruit, engage and motivate our partner community.
  • We believe in the power of remote work, but we also recognize that some in-person connection with team members and customers is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, occasional travel for in-person engagement will be a part of this role. This may include but is not limited to bi-annual department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events will typically be held in varying locations across Canada and the USA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $87,000USD and $117,000USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $87,000 CAD and $117,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

description:
Join to apply for the Amazon Operations Manager role at Sagan Recruitment .

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (EST)

NOTE: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR POSITION

Direct message the job poster from Sagan Recruitment.

Company Overview

Sagan is an exclusive membership community for top executives, founders, and CEOs seeking to hire and maximize the impact of international talent. We bridge the gap between global talent and US-based businesses, connecting candidates from vibrant regions like Latin America, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Africa with leading American companies. Sagan provides a high-performance remote work environment, ensuring access to world-class opportunities for top-tier professionals.

About the Company

Sagan represents a fast-growing direct-to-consumer wellness brand in the pet care space. The company is building a category-defining portfolio through science-backed supplements, oral care, and diagnostics, and is looking for a hands-on Amazon operator to own their 3P performance and growth.

Position Overview

We’re seeking a data-driven, execution-focused Amazon Operations Manager to own the day-to-day health and growth of the brand’s Amazon business. You’ll manage sales performance, reporting, content, and advertising strategies directly through Seller Central. This is a tactical, independent contributor role (no assistant or VA support) ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-autonomy environments. Training will be provided on brand-specific workflows, product catalog, and internal systems to ensure a strong onboarding experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pull and analyze weekly Amazon sales reports to identify performance gaps.
  • Manage listings, pricing, replenishment, and Buy Box optimization within Seller Central.
  • Determine actions based on data – whether issues relate to conversion, stock, product page quality, or advertising performance.
  • Execute and optimize DSP and sponsored ads in coordination with internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor key metrics (TACoS, iROAS, Share of Voice, return rate, etc.) and recommend course corrections.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with future designers or marketing collaborators as the team grows.
  • Stay up to date on Amazon policies and best practices to ensure operational compliance.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years managing Amazon 3P accounts in Seller Central.
  • Strong command of Amazon KPIs, FBA logistics, and ad campaign performance.
  • Highly analytical, able to self-direct and make data-informed decisions.
  • Proficient in Amazon tools like Helium10, Perpetua, or Pacvue.
  • Comfortable working independently without support staff or assistants.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through, proactive and collaborative mindset.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in pet care, wellness, or CPG categories.
  • Exposure to tools like Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), Intentwise, or DSP platforms.
  • Familiarity with cross-functional collaboration (Ops, Creative, Finance).
  • Ability to contribute to broader marketplace strategy over time.

title: Outsource Producer
description:
Overview

Devoted Studios is a US-based game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. With a distributed team of over 1,900+ skilled professionals , we collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles —from AAA titles to emerging technologies. Our team includes talents in external development, pipeline optimization , and creative problem-solving . We are the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

  • 2K
  • Xbox
  • Meta
  • Obsidian Entertainment
  • Turtle Rock Studios
  • Gearbox Software

Devoted Studios is seeking a proactive and experienced Outsource Art Director to join our external game development team. In this dynamic, fast-paced role, your creative vision, technical expertise, and leadership will directly influence the quality and success of our projects and partnerships. You\'ll collaborate with world-class gaming clients and internal teams to drive artistic direction, uphold visual standards, and deliver high-quality assets across a wide range of styles and genres. If you\'re passionate about leading remote art teams, shaping creative solutions, and ensuring flawless execution in external development, we\'d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Develop Comprehensive Proposals: Align client expectations with Devoted\'s expertise — creating structured bids, defining quality targets, and outlining a step-by-step approach to executing on client requirements
  • Client Communication & Clarification: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, clarifying their needs and providing creative, expert recommendations with urgency to quickly close bids
  • Client Calls & Technical Notes: Attend client calls to gather information on scope extensions or potential new projects. Provide clear technical notes to the internal team via JIRA to ensure smooth project execution
  • Bid Collaboration: Work with Business Development and the CEO to finalize bids, ensuring all details are addressed. Create detailed RFPs for the team and manage their progression to maintain momentum
  • Project Transition: Own the transition from pre-production to production, ensuring a seamless handoff of all relevant information including project details, timelines, and rates
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain a steady pipeline of projects, ensuring ongoing visibility into the status and progress of client initiatives
  • Enhance Service Sales: Collaborate with production and leads to improve the sale of tailored services, such as offering small test deliverables, refining how specific services are pitched, updating portfolios and mini-decks, and preparing templated proposals to support sales efforts

Requirements

  • 3-5 years in a similar Art Director, Lead Artist, or External Development role within the video game industry
  • Demonstrated experience directing and delivering outsourced art across various styles and platforms, including detailed feedback and quality control
  • Strong understanding of game art pipelines (2D, 3D, UI/UX, animation, etc.) and the ability to communicate visual requirements and expectations clearly
  • Comfortable working with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) and asset management platforms to coordinate deliveries, milestones, and feedback loops
  • High level of responsiveness and ownership, with the ability to maintain strong client relationships and uphold Devoted\'s reputation for quality and professionalism
  • Creative problem-solver with a collaborative mindset—able to align artistic vision with client goals and propose innovative solutions under tight timelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Willingness to work partially within PST-EST time zones to ensure alignment with clients and internal teams

Benefits

  • Strong and enthusiastic team - opportunity for knowledge sharing, learning, and professional self-development
  • Interesting and challenging tasks - solve diverse and challenging issues, communicate with people within the company as well as with our partners
  • Convenient working conditions - remote work, flexible working hours
  • A chance to work in a highly professional and dynamic team with international game production projects, attractive remuneration package, and opportunities to develop professionally

This is a remote, full-time contracted position.

We are an equal opportunity company and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contract without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : \"work smart\", \"overdeliver\", \"speed is king\" and \"better everyday\". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\'t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

The Data Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining system components that pave the way for data engineers and analysts to deliver their business objectives. This team leverages open-source software, uses cloud infrastructure and services, and builds software to accomplish its mission.

People on this team have different technical backgrounds, such as software engineering, systems administration (Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure and services, data analysis, and data governance.

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Ubuntu Linux, already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, is looking to increase its adoption even further by expanding the number of System On Chip (SoC) platforms supported natively and further optimising to ensure the highest performant experience for all users. There is a strong demand from silicon manufacturers such as NVIDIA, Xilinx, MediaTek, and Qualcomm to provide Ubuntu Linux to their customers and Canonical is looking to broaden its silicon enablement squads to meet this challenge. The Canonical Kernel Team - those responsible for the build, maintenance, and distribution of the Linux kernel for Ubuntu - are looking for individuals with a strong flair for software development at the hardware level and a passion for ensuring the most optimal performance the silicon can provide.
The successful candidate will be able to prove a strong aptitude for software engineering at the hardware level. While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be a substantial advantage, it is not a hard requirement for candidates with prior background in other RTOS' or bare-metal environments as long as direct hardware experience can be demonstrated.
There are a number of work-from-home based roles available worldwide and we are looking for experience levels from early career candidates with a couple of years under their belt up through senior industry veterans.
What your day will look like

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with our silicon vendor partners to integrate their platform support into the Ubuntu Linux kernel for their product ranges
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by partners, customers, the community at large, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take responsibility for the delivery of distinct silicon-optimised variants of the Ubuntu Linux kernel to the world
  • Improve tooling and automation for the delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers
  • Identify new means of maximising performance on partner silicon
What we are looking for in you
  • Well-organised and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Significant programming ability in C
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other aspects of hardware-level system engineering
  • Solid background with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior background with the major SoC families
  • Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with Linux kernel patching and debugging
  • Solid understanding of performance optimisation for silicon platforms
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Home-based work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

WRS Health is seeking a Process Optimization Engineer with a background in Industrial Engineering and a strong passion for operational excellence to lead process improvement initiatives across the organization. This role will be responsible for evaluating and enhancing workflows across multiple internal teams—including HR, Marketing, and Finance—as well as within Operations, with a focus on our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services such as Virtual Assistant support, Billing services, and other client-facing support functions.

.

1. Process Mapping & Redesign

  • Analyze and document current-state workflows across HR, Operations, Marketing, and Finance

  • Design optimized future-state processes to improve quality, speed, and alignment across departments

2. Data-Driven Process Improvement

  • Define and track operational KPIs relevant to each department (e.g., onboarding turnaround, campaign production time, budget approval cycles)
  • Use Lean Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and other continuous improvement methodologies to drive measurable gains in efficiency and performance
  • Deliver actionable insights and process performance reviews using Power BI, Tableau, or Amazon Quicksight

3. Automation & Tool Enablement

  • Recommend and implement technology solutions to eliminate manual steps and improve handoffs across teams
  • Support system integrations between CRMs (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce), finance tools, HR platforms, and marketing automation systems
  • Ensure automation strategies align with compliance, data security, and business continuity standards

4. SOP Development & Documentation

  • Build and maintain clear SOPs, process maps, and training documentation for optimized workflows
  • Standardize documentation practices to ensure continuity and ease of adoption across global and remote teams

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Change Management

  • Partner with stakeholders in HR, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to gather input and drive process ownership
  • Lead pilot programs to test improvements and collect feedback before broader rollout
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement by engaging team leads and reinforcing new practices

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related discipline
Experience
  • 3–7 years of experience in process improvement, operations engineering, or business transformation
  • Hands-on experience supporting shared services teams such as HR, Marketing, Finance, and Operations
  • Healthcare operations or BPO experience is a plus but not required
Technical Skills
  • Skilled in process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Visio, Bizagi)
  • Advanced proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Amazon Quicksight)
  • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce), HR tools, marketing platforms, and finance software
  • Experience with workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, Monday.com) and RPA tools (e.g., UiPath, Zapier)
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher strongly preferred
Preferred Attributes
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to build trust and consensus
  • Systems thinker who can break down complex challenges into simple, scalable solutions

  • Abertura para receber e oferecer feedbacks construtivos.
  • Capacidade clara de organização e de comunicação.

  • Realizar correções on-line de redações em plataforma automatizada, nos modelos Enem e vestibulares, com indicação de nota e comentários para que o aluno melhore o seu desempenho na escrita.

title: Community Associate
description:
Overview

Community Associate

BRASILIA, Corporate Financial Center

The world of work is changing…short commutes, flexibility, and convenience are the minimum standards employees want when it comes to how they want to work!

At IWG, we are leading the way. We’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work from wherever, and however they want…in over 120 countries across the globe!

Join us and help us bring more freedom to people and businesses, while expanding our network. You’ll be able to enjoy a great work life balance and competitive benefits, while growing your career path along the way.

The opportunity

As a Community Associate, you’ll work closely with new and existing customers across a myriad of industries, working to create and maintain your own community within your center, where you will help take care of all the administrative and support needs for your customers…so that your customers can focus on running their business.

A typical day at IWG

You arrive a few minutes before your center opens to make sure everything is ready and check there’s nothing the cleaners have missed.

Customers arrive all throughout the morning. One asks you for a changed WiFi code. Another wants to know if his important package has arrived. A woman needs directions to her meeting room… and can you help her set up the projector and show her where to find a great cup of coffee. You’re off to help her get set-up, as soon as you connect the incoming call to another customer. You may sure that all of the services are properly charged, so that invoices are accurate.

It’s time for a quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

The mail arrives. You sort through it while dealing with a whole host of other customer requests, remembering to email the customer from earlier to let him know his package is waiting for him in his mailbox. And that’s lunch.

A new wave of customers arrive throughout the afternoon. You help a customer with printing and another with their invoice. A customer in a team room say it’s too hot in their office, no problem you are on it and open a ticket in our service portal.

You’ve earned yourself another quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

Early afternoon, you sit down with the Community Manager to discuss the organization of next week’s networking event in your center. You plan and write the e-invites to customers, then create, print and put-up posters on the noticeboards around the center. To your excitement, the Community Manager is coming around the corner with a prospect (someone interested in joining the IWG community), you share a few details about what makes this space so amazing for your customers and encourage them to join the network soon so they can participate in next week’s networking event – then you head back to finish putting up your posters.

The day is coming to a close. Time to gently ask the large group in meeting room 3 to start wrapping up. You direct them to the nice restaurant you know around the corner, so they can grab a bite and continue their discussion. You ensure everything’s nice and tidy, it’s time to head home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who knows how to manage multiple tasks while providing customers with the best possible service. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, with the ability to build strong professional relationships and empathize with people’s needs (Ideally 1+ years of customer service experience)
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic, and able to adapt to fast-changing situations
  • Experience and confidence using MS Office and other basic IT equipment
  • Legally eligible to work in the Country you are applying within and at least 18 years old
  • B1 or higher level of English communication skills

What we offer

On top of a competitive total compensation package, you’ll enjoy:

  • Work life balance(no standard nights/weekends)
  • Generous paid time off plans (sick and vacation)
  • Paid Company Holidays per calendar year (in addition to your PTO accrual)
  • A quarterly bonus plan program, with a competitive salary rate
  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities aligned with great career path opportunities
  • A professional workplace community (business casual attire required)

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and big data technologies

Regular

Pay Range

The targeted base salary for this position is $97,100 to $145,500 per year. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

title: PMO & Best Practice Lead
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

We are looking for a PMO and Best Practices Lead to join our Occupancy Planning and Management team

About JLL -

JLL is a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. As a Fortune 500 company with operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of over 92,000 individuals, we help real estate owners, occupiers, and investors achieve their business ambitions. We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone succeeds, and we are committed to providing an environment where all individuals feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. JLL is a place where everyone can grow no matter how they identify or what background they bring with them. If you’re a leader of any level or experience and this job description resonates with you, let’s talk.

What this job involves –

The Global Program Management Office and Best Practices Lead (Global PMO and Best Practices Lead) will drive process improvement and change within the Occupancy Planning team, establishing an overall process flow, accountability, and reporting to drive efficiency and agility within the Client and JLL Occupancy Planning (OP) teams. They will manage the across planners, reporting and space data insights teams.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Spearheading a comprehensive team development work plan to include:

    • New Occupancy Planning & Management (OPM) org chart implementation

    • Develop associated job descriptions for each OPM role in the team

    • Develop and drive the implementation of a hiring plan for the combined team (JLL/Client)

    • Develop and drive a staff training curriculum and timeline (playbook, standard operating procedures)

  • Partnering with Client Head of Workplace Strategy to implement space governance plan:

    • Build a comprehensive space governance plan and coordinate governance mechanisms

    • Identify a space governance committee for each BRM for the client, to include all four subsidiary organizations

  • Developing and driving the implementation of standardized occupancy planning materials for OP Projects and ongoing OP/MAC work:

    • Co-lead workshops with the Client Workplace Planning leader and JLL team to drive the creation and approval of standardized processes and documents (OP templates, deliverables, process maps, workflows, and playbooks)

    • Co-lead training on standardized OP processes and documents for the combined Client and JLL OP team.

    • Drive integration between JLL Service lines and client contacts

    • Maintain strong linkage to corporate PMO structures and industry best practices

  • Driving CAFM mobilization timeline and reporting progress

    • Manage implementation of technology roadmap, prioritize CAFM projects, and drive positive outcomes for program improvement

  • Driving OPM performance and reporting:

    • Lead account OP tracking, reporting, and review processes for all occupancy planning components, ensuring timely reporting, analysis, and issue resolution.

  • Supporting Change Management:

    • Working with Client Change Management team, indirectly lead the combined Client and JLL OP team in process and change management, training, and integration

Key Strengths

Foster relationships

Great relationship building skills, client focus and team leadership. You’ll foster critical relationships between various individuals and organizations. Simultaneously, supporting coordination and collaboration across various JLL business lines.

Dynamic

Ability to go above and beyond. Demonstrating initiative, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and a result-driven mindset with adaptability to change are a few of the key requirements of the job.

Communication champion

Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to engage at all levels of leadership from administrative to executive level. Ability to understand complex ideas and communicate them to others on the account and client.

Additional Attributes:

  • Results-oriented, client-centric, and strategically adept leader with executive presence. Makes impactful decisions in challenging situations, operating with a sense of urgency and a strong bias towards transformation and execution.

  • Analytical problem-solver and team player: Demonstrates strong analytical skills, effective teamwork, and possesses a structured approach to problem-solving, driving sustainable change by addressing root causes.

  • Skilled in project management, ensuring clarity, timely execution, successful outcomes, and sustainability-focused problem-solving. Effective in structuring, staffing, and managing projects and teams for clarity, timely execution, and corrective action. Demonstrates strong organizational and planning skills.

  • Exhibits perseverance, resourcefulness, adaptability in ambiguous situations, and possesses commercial and financial acumen.

  • Strong cultural alignment: unwavering ethical standards; drives excellence and is innately collaborative.

Success Criteria

  • Deliverables meet expectations and strategic goals without surprises or procedural issues, resulting in high client satisfaction scores.

  • Effective utilization of tools and reports by the account team and a PMO that is known for being easy-to-do-business-with.

  • Seamless integration across service lines and functions, supported by robust reporting, analytics processes, and accurate data for effective decision-making.

Educational Requirements -

  • Expert level of understanding and knowledge of occupancy planning methods and practices

  • Bachelor’s Degree in addition to a broad range of business experience.

  • MBA or similar post-graduate studies preferred.

What you can expect from us -

We believe in the power of collaboration and mutual inspiration, investing in one another's success through support, learning, and celebrating our success. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.

We can’t wait to see where your ambitions take you at JLL. Apply today!

Estimated total compensation for this position:

185,000.00 – 190,000.00 USD per year

The total compensation range is an estimate and not guaranteed. An employment offer is based on an applicant's education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, internal equity and alignment with market data.

Location:

Remote –Los Angeles, CA, New York, NY, San Diego, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington, DC

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits may include:

At Bluelight, we are searching for a candidate to join our client's team as a direct hire.

At The Missing Ingredient, we are passionate about building a better future through food. Founded nearly a decade ago by CJ Bruce, with the mission to "uncomplicate marketing for the world’s most impactful food and beverage companies." They specialize in partnering with brands that are conscious about creating healthy food and beverage options and sustainable practices. The team of self-professed foodies and digital marketing nerds is dedicated to exceeding results and driving measurable success for the brands they love.

They focus on digital marketing services for natural food & beverage companies as well as nonprofit organizations.

Their core services include paid media, social media, email marketing, and influencer relations.


Role Overview
  • The Account Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting client account management and ensuring seamless internal operations. Reporting to the Account Manager, this individual will assist with client communication, task coordination, and project support across digital marketing campaigns, social media, and administrative activities. The position is remote and requires ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
Key Responsibilities
  • Client & Account Support:
  • Support Account Managers in organizing client deliverables and tracking next steps.
  • Join client calls for note-taking and exposure to client communication.
  • Assist in gathering and preparing materials for client meetings and reports.

  • Step in with administrative or coordination support when Account Managers are out.
  • Offer flexible support to meet the evolving needs of the agency.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Project & Task Coordination:
  • Help track project timelines and ensure internal deadlines are documented.
  • Send friendly reminders to team members about upcoming or overdue tasks.
  • Double-check that briefs and resources are shared before tasks begin.
  • Assist in updating task templates and internal workflows under Account Manager guidance.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Team Collaboration & Communication:
  • Meet weekly with Account Managers to understand challenges and support needs.
  • Check in weekly with internal specialists to surface blockers or support needs.
  • Relay specialist feedback to the Account Manager to help inform planning.
  • Coordinate hand-offs between departments (e.g., creative to paid media) to maintain flow.
  • Help facilitate cross-functional collaboration by keeping communication clear and organized.
Success Measurements
  • Client Satisfaction: Positive feedback and relationship strength with client accounts.
  • Project Delivery: Timeliness and quality of deliverables across campaigns.
  • Internal Coordination: Effective communication and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Task Management: High on-time task completion rate with minimal oversight.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 2-3 years in account coordination, marketing, project management, social media, or related fields.
  • Previous remote work experience and ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Attention to detail and resourceful problem-solving ability.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments and openness to feedback.
  • An strong interest in digital marketing and desire to grow in the marketing industry.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and tools like Teamwork, Notion, Slack, and Google Suite.
  • Bonus: Experience in copywriting, content creation, or influencer marketing.
Career Growth & Advancement
  • Potential progression into Account Manager and Senior Account Manager roles based on performance.
  • Opportunities to specialize in client strategy, campaign leadership, or team management with demonstrated proficiency and leadership skills.
Security & Compliance Requirements
  • Adherence to internal confidentiality policies and client-specific data handling requirements.
Reporting & Team Structure
  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with creative, paid media, and influencer marketing teams.
  • No supervisory responsibilities initially but expected to manage tasks and project timelines independently.
Additional Expectations
  • Active participation in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Contribution to a positive, solution-oriented team culture.
  • Commitment to professional development and continuous learning in digital marketing trends.
Compensation Structure
  • The compensation philosophy ensures competitive pay aligned with performance, proficiency, and company affordability. Compensation is reviewed annually based on market benchmarks and individual contributions.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Overview

Solvd is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Following the acquisition of Tooploox, Solvd now offers end-to-end delivery— from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong expertise in end-to-end business analysis . This role requires someone who can effectively collaborate with stakeholders, facilitate requirement discovery, and ensure that business needs are translated into high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in pre-sales activities and the ability to contribute directly to client delivery projects. When not engaged in active delivery, the candidate will support pre-sales initiatives, including proposal development, discovery sessions, and solution shaping, and may be considered for involvement in CMS-related projects. In addition, the candidate should be technically savvy, with a solid understanding of system solution design and its core components, including backend services, frontend applications, APIs, and integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across stakeholder groups to gather, analyze, and document requirements at all stages of the project lifecycle (from initiation/discovery through development and maintenance).
  • Communicate directly with customers to elicit high-level requirements and convert them into detailed documentation such as Vision & Scope, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, UML diagrams, and process flows.
  • Develop and maintain product backlogs (epics, features, user stories) to guide Agile development teams.
  • Facilitate workshops and decision-making sessions to align customer expectations and technical delivery.
  • Execute impact-mapping of requirements and manage change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead verification of designs against requirements, providing recommendations to resolve any issues.
  • Support PMs with timelines, roadmaps, milestones, and sprint planning.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in Jira, Confluence/other tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience across the full BA cycle (pre-sales, discovery, delivery, and support).
  • Strong ability to elicit, document, and manage requirements using BA artifacts (Vision & Scope, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, diagrams, etc.).
  • Experience with impact mapping and change request management.
  • Skilled in backlog management, sprint planning, and Agile delivery support.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Confident in facilitating workshops, leading meetings, and driving decision-making.
  • Strong command of English (B2+/C1 level).
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence or similar tools.
  • Ability to work independently (the only BA on the project) and collaboratively in a BA team environment.
  • Motivated, proactive, and passionate about customer success and growth.
  • Experienced in supporting multicultural, distributed teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI/ML, or digital transformation projects.
  • BA certifications (CBAP, CCBA, Agile BA, PO, etc.).

What you’ll get

  • Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation.
  • Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures.
  • Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards.

Ready to make an impact? If you’re excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry’s sharpest minds, apply today and let’s innovate together.

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.

  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

Our customers' success is our success, and as Customer Success Analyst you will play a crucial role in this journey.

In your day-to-day, you will assist, guide and support our customers through our service channels (e-mail, phone and online ticket).

If you have good interpersonal relationship, enjoy working with customer service, are communicative and like technology, this opportunity is for you.

What you'll do:

  • Assist clients on how to use our products focusing on their success;
  • Solve questions and offer specific guidance as required;
  • Create documentation for procedures when necessary;
  • Identify possibilities for improvement with customers and the Customer Success team;
  • Work in other activities related to the team.
What we need you to have:
  • Graduation completed or in progress;
  • Good communication and persuasion skills;
  • Proactivity and resilience;
  • Ability to manage conflicts;
  • Good interpersonal relationship;
It would be awesome if you have:
  • Experience with customer service;
  • Knowledge of tools and service channels focused on the customer experience;
  • Familiarity with digital products and day-to-day technologies;
  • Graduation in Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related fields (graduated or in course);
  • Experience with Git.
  • Health insurance assistance;
  • Flexible hours;
  • Nice and informal environment;
  • Daily challenges;
  • Awesome team!
Our Team

Here in Arca we prioritize teamwork always focusing in our end users and constant innovation.

We have a diverse, integrated team, where professionals from different areas develop digital solutions together, thinking about our products, overcoming challenges, discovering new possibilities, with the final goal of meet the needs of our clients through beautiful experiences.

That's not an easy task, and we believe that passion and constant improvement from people and processes are essential on this journey.

We like to work together, beat challenges, improve our skills and learn from each other in everything we do.

Join our team, you'll be more than welcome!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.

The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
